title: Sound Service State
description: Synthesises audio from note events using the Web Audio API, with synth and drum modes. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/sound)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

waveType.description: Oscillator waveform for synth mode. One of sine, triangle, square, sawtooth, organ, soft, fifth

noteDuration.description: How long a synth note is held before its release, in noteDurationUnit

noteDurationUnit.description: Seconds, or beats of a tempo (see *Envelope*)

attack.description: Seconds a synth note takes to rise to full volume

release.description: Seconds a synth note takes to fade once it is no longer held

tempoSlot.description: The slot a tempo in BPM is read from when the input carries none

drumMap.description: Map of note name → drum type for drums mode

trigger.description: What to play for an input that names no note of its own, such as a Timer tick: a note name, or in drums mode also "kick", "snare" or "hihat". Unset, such an input plays nothing. A note the input names always wins.
